name: Legendary Arcanist
body:
For some, magic is a birthright. For others, it is a lifelong devotion. For the legendary arcanist, it is a tool; one of many. The legendary arcanist possesses a talent for magic, but rather than study long and hard to nurture it, they choose a few areas they have an aptitude for and concentrate their efforts there. For everything else, they rely on more traditional tools. They are not interested in theories or detailed explanations; they want to know what they need to know.

Alignment: Any.

Hit Die: d6.

Starting Wealth: 4d6 × 10 gp (average 140 gp.) In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class Skills

The legendary arcanist’s class skills are Bluff (Cha), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Fly (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (all) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Profession (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Use Magic Device (Cha).

Skill Ranks per Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Class Features
Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A legendary arcanist is proficient with all simple weapons, plus the hand axe, light flail, light hammer, light pick, shortbow, shortsword, and sword cane.

Legendary arcanists are also proficient with light armor and buckler shields. A legendary arcanist can cast legendary arcanist spells while wearing light armor or a buckler shield without incurring the normal arcane spell failure chance, but wearing any other armor or shield incurs a chance of arcane spell failure if the spell being cast has a somatic component.

A multiclass legendary arcanist still incurs the normal arcane spell failure chance for arcane spells received from other classes.

Spellcasting

A legendary arcanist casts arcane spells drawn from their spell list. Each legendary arcanist has a unique spell list created by selecting affinities, each of which contributes spells to their list. A legendary arcanist must prepare their spells ahead of time, but unlike a wizard, their spells are not expended when they’re cast. Instead, they can cast any spell that they have prepared consuming a spell slot of the appropriate level, assuming they haven’t yet used up their spell slots per day for that level.

To learn, prepare, or cast a spell, the legendary arcanist must have an Intelligence score equal to at least 10 + the spell’s level. The saving throw DC against a legendary arcanist’s spell is 10 + the spell’s level + the legendary arcanist’s Intelligence modifier.

A legendary arcanist can only cast a certain number of spells of each spell level per day. Their base daily spell allotment is given on Table 1: Legendary Arcanist Class Features under “Spells per Day.” In addition, they receive bonus spells per day if they have a high Intelligence score.

The number of spells the legendary arcanist can prepare each day is limited and is determined by their class level as indicated on Table 2: Legendary Arcanist Spells Prepared. Unlike the number of spells they can cast per day, the number of spells a legendary arcanist can prepare each day is not affected by their Intelligence score. Feats and other effects that modify the number of spells known by a spellcaster instead affect the number of spells a legendary arcanist can prepare.

A legendary arcanist must choose and prepare their spells ahead of time by getting 8 hours of rest and spending 1 hour studying their spellbook. While studying, the legendary arcanist decides what spells to prepare and refreshes their available spell slots for the day.

Like a spontaneous caster, a legendary arcanist can choose to apply any metamagic feats they know to a prepared spell as they cast it, with the same increase in casting time. However, they may also prepare a spell with any metamagic feats they know and cast it without increasing casting time like a prepared caster.

These options cannot be combined: a spell prepared with metamagic feats cannot be further modified with another metamagic feat at the time of casting (unless the legendary arcanist has the metamixing arcanist exploit).

Spellbooks

A legendary arcanist must study their spellbook each day to prepare their spells. They can’t prepare any spell not recorded in their spellbook, except for read magic (which they can prepare from memory), or spells which they prepared the previous day.

A legendary arcanist begins play with a spellbook containing all 0-level spells on their spell list, plus four 1st—level spells from their spell list of their choice.

At each new legendary arcanist level, they gain two new spells of any spell level or levels that they can cast (based on their new class level) for their spellbook. At any time, a legendary arcanist can also add spells found in wizards’ or other arcanists’ spellbooks to their own, provided those spells are on their spell list.

Arcanists can prepare a number of cantrips, or 0-level spells, each day as noted on Table 2: Legendary Arcanist Spells Prepared. These spells are cast like any other spell, but they do not consume spell slots. As with their other spells, these spells are not expended when cast.

Arcane Affinities

A legendary arcanist’s spell list is divided into affinities that describe the general themes they have natural talent with and which they can hone through study. Every legendary arcanist gains the universal affinity, and 3 more affinities of their choice at 1st level. The legendary arcanist’s spell list is made up of the spells from their affinities. They can prepare any spell from their arcane affinities if they have that spell in their spellbook and are of sufficient level.

If an exploit or archetype adds additional spells to the legendary arcanist’s class list, it is added to the universal affinity, unless stated otherwise.

Arcanist Exploits (Su)

The legendary arcanist may choose exploits from the traditional arcanist’s list of exploits.

Sidebar: Arcanist Exploits and the Legendary Arcanist

Certain exploits work differently for the legendary arcanist.

If the legendary arcanist takes the Familiar exploit, they add the following spells to their spell list: 2nd – companion life link, merge with familiar, 3rd – polymorph familiar, 4th – familiar melding, 5th – companion transposition, duplicate familiar, 6th – transfer familiar
The legendary arcanist cannot take the Potent Magic exploit. They are considered to have it already for purposes of qualifying for other abilities.
If the legendary arcanist refills their arcane reservoir using any exploit, those additional points are temporary and are the first points to be used when they spend points from their reservoir. Temporary points stack, but the legendary arcanist loses one temporary point from their reservoir at the end of each of their turns.

Abilities that can refill their reservoir can be used an unlimited number of times per day, even if the exploit says otherwise (such as Consume Magic Items).

Arcane Reservoir (Su)

A legendary arcanist has an innate pool of magical energy that they can draw upon to fuel their arcanist exploits and enhance their spells. Each day, when preparing spells, the legendary arcanist’s arcane reservoir fills with raw magical energy, gaining a number of points equal to their Int modifier + their Cha modifier. Any points they had from the previous day are lost.

The legendary arcanist can also gain these points through other class features (consume spells) and some arcanist exploits, but points gained this way are only temporary. The legendary arcanist spends these points first but loses one temporary point at the end of each of their turns. There is no maximum to the number of points that a legendary arcanist can have in their reservoir.

Points from the arcanist reservoir are used to fuel many of the legendary arcanist’s powers.

Arcane Surge (Su)

The legendary arcanist can enhance their spells in powerful ways using their arcane reservoir. When they cast a legendary arcanist spell, they may expend 1 point from their arcane reservoir as a free action to surge the spell. The surge adds a +1 bonus to the spell which can be applied in a number of different ways, and that bonus increases by +1 every 4 levels after the first to a maximum of 5 at 17th level.

There are 2 ways to surge a spell:

Potent Surge: The bonus is applied to the caster level of the spell.
Persistent Surge: Half the bonus (rounded up) is applied to the saving throw DC of the spell.

A spell may only be surged in one way. Multiple uses of this ability do not stack.

Consume Spells (Su)

At 1st level, a legendary arcanist can expend an available legendary arcanist spell slot as a move action, making it unavailable for the rest of the day, just as if they had used it to cast a spell. Doing this adds 1 point to their arcane reservoir, regardless of the level of the spell slot consumed. Cantrips (0 level spells) cannot be consumed this way.

Unconventional Thinking (Ex)

At 3rd level, the legendary arcanist learns to apply their intelligence to problems usually solved by other means. They may choose a skill that normally applies a Dexterity, Wisdom or Charisma modifier to its result.

The legendary arcanist may attempt checks with that skill using their Intelligence modifier instead of the normal modifier for that skill.

For every 4 levels after the 3rd, they may choose another skill, until they have a total of 5 skills at 19th level.

Greater Exploits (Su)

At 10th level, the legendary arcanist may choose greater exploits from the traditional arcanist’s list of greater exploits.

Sudden Exploit (Ex)

At 19th level, whenever the legendary arcanist successfully casts a spell using a 9th level spell slot, they may use an exploit that can normally be used as a standard, move, or swift action as a free action instead. This must occur immediately after the casting.

Ultimate Exploit

At 20th level, the legendary arcanist gains one ultimate exploit. They may choose one of the following options:

Broader Education

The legendary arcanist gains 3 additional exploits.

Deep Reservoir

The legendary arcanist has enough power to blast things all day long. Their arcane reservoir increases by 10.

Exploitive Magic

Once per day, as a free action, the legendary arcanist can gain an exploit of their choice. They retain that exploit for the rest of the day.

Magical Supremacy

The legendary arcanist learns how to convert their arcane reservoir into spells. They can cast any spell they have prepared by expending a number of points from their arcane reservoir equal to the level of the spell to be cast, instead of spending a spell slot.

Supreme Savant

The legendary arcanist gains an additional affinity of their choice. In addition, they gain 10 spells from that affinity which they may immediately add to their spellbook for free.

Favored Class Bonuses

The following favored class bonuses are available to all legendary arcanists, regardless of race:

+1/2 of a new spell prepared. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the legendary arcanist can cast unless they have reached 20th level.
+1/3 of an unconventional thinking skill
+1/6 of an arcanist exploit
+1/6 of a metamagic feat
+1/2 point in the legendary arcanist’s arcane reservoir
+1 bonus on all concentration checks made to cast legendary arcanist spells defensively
+1/4 competence bonus to all skill checks that use Intelligence
Add one spell from the legendary arcanist’s spell list to their spell book
